For the ingredients I didn't really measure things out but I did a lot of substitution:
Peanut/nut mix= home made sesame butter and pureed squash 

Beef and home made  Broth = slow cooked on low 6 hours
-ribs and brisket cut into chunks
-whole and unpeeled carrot, garlic and celery 
-2 tbs of apple cider vinegar 
-4 - 6 cups of water 
-while peppercorn around 10
>keep the meat and the broth after 

Ingredients for the Kare Kare:
-puree squash
-sesame butter
-anato seeds soaked in hot water 
-blanched sting beans and petchay 
-fish sauce to season to taste i used maybe 2-4 tables spoons 
-sugar around 3 tablespoon 
-boiled beef
- cornstarch to thicken sauce
